buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 3. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Sports Authority of India, Aurangabad payable at Aurangabad . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 5. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Terms and conditions: 1) Service provider is required to pay salaries / wages of contracted staff d eployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own which can be up to three months and then claim payment from buyer along with all statutory docu ments like PF, ESIC challan PT etc. as well as the bank statement of salary to staff along with salary slip. The service provider should not make any o ther deductions such as contribution to society, caution deposit etc other than the statutory deductions. 2) Bidder should have its Geographic Presence: The bidders should have a registered office situated in the state of Maharashtra, near to SAI NCOE C hhatrapati Sambhajinagar i.e. in Municipal Corporation of Chhatrapati Sha mbhajinagar or District Chhatrapati Shambhajinagar. 3) The bidder shall submit the following documents for verification by the Buyer and upload the same along with the bid so as to verified the geographic presence. i. Electricity Bills for the last three months; ii. Valid Online / offline Registration, Leave and Licence Agreement; iii. No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the landlord on a non-judicial stamp paper/bond; and iv. Municipal Tax Receipts for the last one years.

Submission of the above documents is mandatory. Failure to furnish any of the aforesaid documen ts may render the bid liable for rejection. 4) The bidder should provide contract labour license for providing houseke eping staff service as per the CLRA Act 1950 from Shram Suvidha portal o r Maharashtra Contract labour (regulation and Abolition) Act, 1971. They s hould submit copy of Shram Suvidha CLC Annual Return in case of CLRA A ct 1950. 5) Copy of the Annual Turnover Certificate for the last three (03) financial years, duly certified by a Chartered Accountant an average annual turnov er of not less than Rs. 1.25 crore (Rupees One Crore Twenty-Five La khs Only). 6) Bidder must ensure the submission of similar work order only from any of the PSU/State / Central Government organizations. 7) Bidder must ensure the submission of similar work completion certificat e only from any of the State / Central Government organizations. 8) Solvency certificate minimum 33 lakhs from nationalized bank (not abov e six month) as on the last date of submission of the bid. 9) Should furnish valid ISO-9001 certificate for providing Housekeeping ma npower services 10) Should have minimum 3 years experience in providing Housekeeping m anpower services 11) Should submit minimum wages compliance certificate from the current client stating that the contractor is paying wages in accordance with mini mum wages notified by the Chief Labour Commissioner Central to the em ployees engaged in various day-to-day activities. 12) Should submit proof of remittance of ESIC, PF, GST etc. 13) Should have registered under GST Act.

14) ITR for past 03 years along with balance sheet and profit & loss stateme nt (FY. 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25) 15) Current client list with contract value details. 16) The service provider is required to have previous evidence of having ho usekeeping comparable manpower deployment experience for at least on e year. Necessary documents relating to such Housekeeping service will b e uploaded by the bidder for verification of the buyer. 17) Undertaking regarding not blacklisted or debarred by any Govt. entity (f ormat enclosed) 18) Successful bidder needs to provide police verification certificate, medic al fitness certificate and address proof of the engaging manpower to SAI, NCOE Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar. 19) The successful bidder needs to mandatory provide uniform to the engag ing manpower to SAI, NCOE Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar. 20) The selected vendor is required to retain the existing resource currently employed by the previous agency and ensure their continuation at their r espective workplaces. Any new resources, if engaged through the agency will be through the selection committee of NCOE Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar. 21) The bidder / contractor submission of a copy of the valid statutory licenc e along with the bid is mandatory, under the provisions of the Occup ational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020 and the rules, regulations, bye-laws, standards, notifications, or orders made or iss ued thereunder by the Competent Authority. Failure to furnish the requisit e licence as applicable, shall render the bid liable to be rejected. 22) The Code on Wages, 2019, employer shall pay minimum rates wages notified by central government to employees before the expiry of the sev enth day of the succeeding month, the Code safeguards employees’ inter ests through universal minimum wages, ensuring dignity and timely paym ent of wages. 23) Successful bidders are required to install biometric machine for attendance at the campus and mu st submit biometric attendance along with the bill is mandatory for payment.
